name: radio
description: Two-way real-time messaging in SQL. Subscribe to WebSocket / message-bus channels, query received events as a normal table, and broadcast outgoing messages with delivery tracking. Real-time pipelines that stay in DuckDB.

cta.title: DuckDB on the Wire
cta.description: Install Radio to subscribe to WebSocket / event channels, buffer incoming events as queryable rows, and broadcast outgoing messages — all from SQL.
